name: magnos
description: Finance workflows on your own exported files: close review, bank reconciliation, budget variance, Excel model review, SaaS metrics, data profiling, board pack and HTML pages. Every figure is computed in code and checked against the files. No account needed.

interface.longDescription: Magnos turns your exported trial balances, ledgers, bank statements, budgets, CRM and subscription files into reviewed results: a month-end close review, a bank reconciliation that ties out, budget against actual with the lines that explain the gap, an Excel model review before the board sees it, ARR and retention, a profile of any export, a one-page board pack and a self-contained HTML page. All arithmetic runs in code, every figure is checked against the files, and answers are written short and exact.
defaultPrompt: Review this month's close against last month.
Where are we over budget this year?
Profile these exports before I analyze them.
